notes: Normalized break-even parameters for the P0-3 closure identity. All quantities are dimensionless ratios, so the model produces no factual claim about any process, vendor, or deployment. The grids are report-side illustrations. Published-effect anchors are reused from `03`'s existing source list; this file adds no new literature and creates no new numeric identities.

where.s: gross execution-time saving as a share of baseline minutes per attempt
where.rho: review + remediation minutes as a share of baseline minutes per attempt
where.p: probability that a candidate outcome is verified AND persists over the measurement window
where.i: allocated integration / mapping cost per attempt, as a share of baseline labor cost per outcome
where.a: AI / tool / runtime / retry cost per attempt, as a share of baseline labor cost per outcome

placement_note: i and a are per-attempt costs and enter the numerator before the /p division, per P0-3 §17.5 (integration cost must not be allocated only to successful workflows after the fact).

published_effect_anchors.name: Brynjolfsson / Li / Raymond — Generative AI at Work
published_effect_anchors.reported: productivity +14% on average across 5,179 support agents, heterogeneous
published_effect_anchors.conversion: if productivity means outcomes per unit time, time per outcome falls by 1 - 1/1.14
